verdict.rationale: Foreloop's 'skills' concept (foreloop-docs-10, foreloop-docs-39) lets teams codify recurring corrections/conventions that are then carried into task contracts so agents start with 'your team's expectations,' which functions similarly to a context file for codebase conventions. However, there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'context file' format, how to author/store it, or examples showing it shaping generated plans/code beyond task execution skills. Missing for 10: explicit context-file mechanism (format, location, scope), documentation on how conventions influence code generation specifically (vs. task skills), and independent verification of effect on plan/code quality.
